hero.headline: Made slowly. Kept for years.
hero.subheadline: Ceramics, linen and light from small workshops, chosen to be used every day.

image.alt: Stoneware mugs and a linen throw on an oak table in morning light

editorial.headline: Every Ondo mug starts as 400 grams of clay
body: Each piece is thrown, trimmed and glazed by hand, so no two are quite the same.
Small differences in colour and form are part of the object, not a flaw.

image.alt: Hands shaping a mug on a potter's wheel
